I’m really fed up with these - constantly failing to connect to both speakers and when I do one often drops out inexplicably. Usually with the message to move closer or to recharge the speaker(s). I’ve disconnected, I’ve switched on / off etc and still get ‘mobile device not found’ etc etc.

reviews.title: Poor user experience
reviews.text:
Bose makes it difficult to connect to multiple Bluetooth devices. It would be helpful if, on opening the app, the Connections screen pops up immediately so users can choose which Bluetooth device they want to connect to. 

Instead, my headphones connect to devices that aren’t turned on. When I open the app I get prompted to a screen wherei have to slide my finger to connect to my phone. If I want to connect to anything other than my phone, which is usually the case, there’s no direct way, not even a menu option, to access the Connections screen.

Not having an option to choose which device I want to connect to is so frustrating and a waste of time

reviews.title: Very Finicky
reviews.text: App does not consistently connect to “supported” devices. Sometimes uninstalling and reinstalling helps, but it’s extremely frustrating for such a high end speaker product. Stereo and party modes for multiple speakers require even more effort and rarely work properly. My friends are connecting their JBL, HK and even freebie speakers, and laughing as I’m struggling with my Bose speakers and this app. Not a great look Bose, do better.

reviews.title: Hardware is great. Software is rubbish
reviews.text: Just buggy and poor. Seriously. You are doing your hardware a disservice.

reviews.title: Great Speakers, Bad App.
reviews.text: Absolutely a failure of an app if you want to connect two Pro S1 speakers via Bluetooth… multiple attempts will finally succeed.  I’d expect more from Bose. Seemingly the app has not improved since I acquired the speakers in 2021. (It’s 2026 now). Two stars, because the speakers are great . Please improve for this particular issue: two speakers on Bluetooth

reviews.title: Can’t connect to devices anymore
reviews.text: This was good, but the app doesn’t even work anymore. The most frustrating thing is that I can no longer connect both of my Bose speakers

reviews.title: Great speakers, Kindergarten level app.
reviews.text: I love Bose products. Speakers? great. Headphones? Wonderful. Noise cancelling? Heavenly. So why in the name of everything holy and unholy is this app so bad? It used to SORT of work SOMETIMES. I could connect two speakers but no more for maybe 25 to 30 minutes before one fell off fir no reason even if they were in line-of-sight of each other and no more than 10 feet apart. Now? Nothing. Zip. Tried all three speakers individually and separately. I tried them already connected to my phone, not connected to my phone, and after I ‘forgot device’ on my phone. How can most of a company be the best in business then hire a room full of constipated squirrels to run their apps? OH! I almost forgot. I thought maybe it might work if I actually made an account and signed in even though I don’t see why buying a speaker from a company all of a sudden means we have to have a relationship and hold hands at the theatre. Freaks.  But I was willing to try in order to, once more, PLAY MUSIC OUT OF TWO SPEAKERS AT ONCE IN 2026! Yet still it didn’t work. Thanks for nothing a-holes. It’s not like I have a million other things to do with my time. (That’s sarcasm for people who don’t speak English as a first language,, I very much have TONS of things to do other than sit with a phone and three speakers and an app created by a multi-billion dollar company trying to make that app fo what it was designed to do and which should have been easy ten years ago.)

reviews.title: I wanted to like this device
